newsitem.title: USA: Motorola introduces secure PC card modem.
newsitem.headline: Motorola introduces secure PC card modem.

text.p: Motorola's Mobile Computing Products Division introduced Friday its SecureSURFR PC Card modem, combining 33.6 kilobit per second computer connection speeds with network security systems.

The modem automatically detects a request for authentication, requests the user's personal identification number, and automatically responds with corresponding authentication information. The modem can also be connected to Motorola cellular phones, the company said.

With more workers accessing company networks from home or on the road, unauthorized user access is a growing concern, Motorola said. Motorola said the SecureSURFR helps monitor and control dial-in access to networks.
